svg.title: mnichols08’s GitHub constellation
svg.desc: 22 public repositories arranged in a deterministic star field. Solid lines connect projects through selected languages and topics; detected languages include secondary languages; dotted bridges join nearby groups visually and do not represent dependencies. 227 of 227 shared connections shown. Brighter paths emphasize nearby relationships; faint paths preserve the remaining selected overlaps.
